title: plans for cross attention?
body:
Hi, thanks for the work, here and in the accompanying text and research, it's really fascinating

as far as I can tell, `power_full` only supports causal self attention, since (1) the query sequence length and the kv sequence length must be the same (at least, they aren't distinguished), and (2) the causal mask is applied within the `_attention` call.  

it looks like there is a notion of causal/full and self/cross in the c++ kernel source , but only the causal kernels are generated, and in fact causal is hard-coded to true in a few places.

do you have plans or otherwise suggestions for cross attention? I had considered just using the numerically stable python implementation from your article and removing the causal mask, but figured I could ask here beforehand
author: jaswon

comments.body: after some more investigation, it seems like the main focus of this effort (and other similar "linear" attention operators) is the causal case, so i'm going to close this issue

Hey! Sorry, forgot to reply. We are actually planning to release an update version that includes non causal attention (in fact, we are interested in a way of interpolating between causal and non causal). You can expect the feature to come over the next few months, but right now this is not our highest priority. For now I would recommend just using the reference pytorch attention without the masking.

I'm curious. What tasks are you interested in that require non causal attention?
thanks for the suggestion! as for my use case, i would say it's most similar to audio transcription, so the decoder would be cross attending to a representation of the audio.
